safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Failing to document that there was no evidence of cellulitis omits an important negative assessment that could help future clinicians avoid unnecessary antibiotics or escalation if the patient re-presents with the same bite site concern. While the immediate clinical risk is low, it can lead to unnecessary monitoring/treatment due to unclear documentation of infection status.
